# Benjamin Eidam (benjamineidam.com)

> Benjamin Eidam is an AI expert, consultant, and trainer from Leipzig, Germany. His website, benjamineidam.com, shares deep insights on AI development and practical ways to integrate AI into organizations.

Scope: This file represents the conceptual, strategic, and educational layers of Benjamin Eidam’s AI work — not personal or private data.

benjamineidam.com serves as both a knowledge base and a professional profile.  
It combines thought leadership on AI strategy with practical tools, educational programs, and project showcases.  
The site is primarily designed for tech-savvy executives and decision-makers seeking to understand and apply AI effectively in their business context.

Benjamin also develops and tests “AGI-Proof” writing — a method for creating content built on timeless, irreducible principles designed to remain relevant across paradigm shifts in AI development and cognition.  
This approach blends empirical grounding (from research and primary sources) with anticipatory reasoning about how future intelligent systems will interpret and evolve ideas.  
Further details are available at [AGI Proof Experiments](https://benjamineidam.com/About-me.html#agi-proof).

## Core Content

- [Homepage](https://benjamineidam.com): Overview of Benjamin Eidam’s work, projects, and philosophy on AI.  
- [Articles](https://benjamineidam.com/artikel-articles): Articles exploring AI trends, tools, business integration, and strategic perspectives.  
- [Newsroom](https://benjamineidam.com/newsroom): Media features, guest articles, and press coverage.  
- [Book "Der KI-Schlüssel für Unternehmen" (Springer-Gabler)](https://benjamineidam.com/ki-schluessel): Publications authored by Benjamin Eidam.  
- [About](https://benjamineidam.com/About-me.html): More about Benjamin Eidam's work and approach.
